outcome_summary: The model-settings-rework-3 cycle closed all deferred items from the three-session hardening series across six work packages: Route.method was narrowed to a discriminated HttpMethod union for compile-time safety, the ~630-line buildRoutes() monolith was decomposed into six domain sub-builders with a zero-argument getRouteDescriptors() test factory, dedicated dispatchRoute() unit tests were added using a real createServer()/fetch pattern, all 6 OWASP A05 error-message information-disclosure paths in model-registry.ts were hardened with generic client messages and stderr logging, and @throws JSDoc coverage was completed for all 52 API client methods. All 3,605 tests pass and TypeScript builds cleanly; the architectural vision of the model-settings series is now fully realized.
project_summary: Complete the model-settings hardening series by narrowing the Route.method type to a discriminated union for compile-time safety, decomposing the 630-line buildRoutes() function into domain-focused sub-builders, adding dedicated dispatchRoute() unit tests, eliminating OWASP A05 error-message information disclosure in all Model Registry error paths, completing @throws JSDoc coverage for all API client methods, and cleaning up manifest artifacts.
